selector5_same_generation_capture_requir: A rigorous selector5 replay needs one same-generation sidecar with graph patch descriptors [patchNodeOffset,nodeCount,matrixOffset,pivotOffset], sorted global patch-node IDs, graph row map, node-to-patch CSR offsets/values, per-node coverage, original pre-LU patch matrices, in-place LU, final row pivots, factor-valid words, effective P/AP, selected base or augmented RAP LU/pivots/validity, modeCount/modeStride, candidate node fixed/free tags, selected/healthy status, and source/world/program/device plus control/substep/microtick/micro-generation/Newton/dt and candidate-history digests. Patch RHS/coefficient dumps are input-specific and cannot stand in for this map. An arbitrary-vector native output would be needed to verify native forward action; source149 has no selector5 transpose kernel, so transpose parity remains CPU algebraic only.

selector5_source_derivation.capture_point_required: after graph patch matrix assembly/factorization and coarse RAP construction for the exact selected Newton linearization, before any later generation can overwrite the arrays
selector5_source_derivation.forward_real_arithmetic: c=R^-1 P^T r; q=r-AP c; patch_rhs=E q; patch_solution=D patch_rhs; S r=P c+G patch_solution
selector5_source_derivation.refined_patch_map: For exact real arithmetic, with F denoting the captured pivoted-LU solve and A_p the captured original patch matrix, D=F+F(I-A_p F)=2F-F A_p F. The production implementation is FP32 and uses a two-word compensated residual plus a conditional exact-zero refinement skip; the formula is not a bitwise FP32 emulation.
selector5_source_derivation.transpose_real_arithmetic: H=G D E; S=H+(P-HQ)R^-1P^T; S^T=H^T+P R^-T(P^T-Q^T H^T), H^T=E^T D^T G^T, D^T=2F^T-F^T A_p^T F^T.
